notes.title: Now the player data will save to steam
notes.content:
Save game file has been changed a lot, so the old save file will no longer support.

[h1]Now your data will save on your steam account, like highest level, coin, and research data.[/h1]

notes.title: Procedural generate random levels are now available!
notes.content:
[h3]This time with a major update, the infinite random maze is ready[/h3]

[h1]After completing the tutorial levels, you will enter an infinite random maze, random enemies[/h1]

In order to deal with increasingly powerful enemies, an infinite enhancement attribute feature has been added. The gold coins obtained after each kill of the enemy can be used to enhance the player tank ball ability.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36384578/b6c89a0ec4c5ae700f9afcab2e9ec22fa1fc142f.jpg[/img]
